notes.title: 1 year of development!
notes.notes:
We have been in development for one year.

On February 4, the game celebrated exactly one year in development, moving from draft to early access!

I want to share this update with as many people as possible.
I have therefore translated the game by adding two new languages (German) and completing the third (Spanish).

If you find errors in the translations, please let me know!

notes.title: 11 months of development!
notes.notes:
We finally give character to the first images of this adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43224616/aa34d635f11c1f3dff325f137a9685e90931f815.gif[/img]

The plot is still the same but the narrative, as many have pointed out, is lacking!
During these 3 weeks of Early access, I have heard so many opinions and I summarize them here:

PLOT:

many have figured out the plot and what is happening to the player, but what is perceived is still little compared to what the main character can tell about his life, the discovery of his illness, the world out there, how much has changed and how! what this technology was born from! or even simply how the game is connected to its sequel

DIFFICULTY:

The perception for someone who is a puzzle player versus someone who is a neophyte is very different, one of the requests I get is to include different difficulties, it is possible to do that but I have yet to figure out if it is the right way!
one idea I appreciated is to create a DLC that already takes the mechanics of the base game however with a much higher difficulty, for those who appreciate the mechanics and want to see them pushed

GRAPHICS:

The Lumen effect was really appreciated! I always thank Unreal Engine that gave me easy access to these technologies.
It has been pointed out to me several times that in the last levels graphically is lacking but I wanted to remind you that it is currently a PORTING, so especially in the last levels, the environment is designed for smartphone access and not PC/CONSOLE
